description: The four convolutions of the Eagan Matrix and the pre-effects and post-effects convolution sends; it works through a CHEM Core

params.text: Sets how much of the pre-effects convolution is mixed with the dry signal
Chooses which of the four impulse responses feeds the pre-effects convolution, blending between two neighbours at settings in between
Sets how much of the post-effects convolution is mixed with the dry signal
Chooses which of the four impulse responses feeds the post-effects convolution, blending between two neighbours at settings in between
Picks the impulse response for that row from nineteen datasets, from Waterphone 1 through the gongs to White and Grey noise; right-click for the list, or drag through them
Sets the length of that row's impulse response, and modulating it while the instrument is making sound produces artefacts
Sets the tuning of that row's impulse response, and modulating it while the instrument is making sound produces artefacts
Sets the width of that row's impulse response, and modulating it while the instrument is making sound produces artefacts
Sets the strength of that row's impulse response in the left channel
Sets the strength of that row's impulse response in the right channel
Sets how far the voltage at the selected input moves its control, from -100% to 100%, a negative amount inverting the voltage; the knob does nothing until a cable is patched
Turns on phase cancellation across the convolutions

inputs.text: Moves the pre-effects convolution mix away from its knob setting, bipolar, scaled by the modulation amount knob and clamped to 0-10V
Moves the pre-effects impulse response choice away from its knob setting, bipolar, scaled by the modulation amount knob and clamped to 0-10V
Moves the post-effects convolution mix away from its knob setting, bipolar, scaled by the modulation amount knob and clamped to 0-10V
Moves the post-effects impulse response choice away from its knob setting, bipolar, scaled by the modulation amount knob and clamped to 0-10V
Moves that row's impulse response length away from its knob setting, bipolar, scaled by the modulation amount knob and clamped to 0-10V
Moves that row's impulse response tuning away from its knob setting, bipolar, scaled by the modulation amount knob and clamped to 0-10V
Moves that row's impulse response width away from its knob setting, bipolar, scaled by the modulation amount knob and clamped to 0-10V
Moves that row's left-channel strength away from its knob setting, bipolar, scaled by the modulation amount knob and clamped to 0-10V
Moves that row's right-channel strength away from its knob setting, bipolar, scaled by the modulation amount knob and clamped to 0-10V

notes: nothing reaches the instrument until the module is linked to a CHEM Core; putting it beside a linked CHEM module links it, or click the link button at the bottom of the panel to pick a Core
one input at a time is under the modulation amount knob; patching a cable moves the knob to that jack and lights the lamp beside it, and clicking a jack or its label moves the knob to that one
length, tuning, width and the dataset choice were meant to be set once in a preset; a fixed voltage or a slow sequencer suits them, while continuous modulation gives clicks and glitches
some presets drive the convolution parameters from their own macro assignments, and a knob turned here fights that
menu: Zero modulation — sets the modulation amount on every input of this module to zero
